Once any patient at The Royal Shrewsbury Hospital is initiated on a new prescribed drug during an admission, no written record is ever made anywhere by anyone including pharmacy; nurses; doctors or consultants explaining or counselling the patient upon the possible side-effects or complications as a result of taking a specific prescribed drug; nor is there any written record on what to look out for and what to do in such circumstances and where they can get assistance.
lack of written record of side-effect counselling
